technique_name: Explain why global warming is a threat to human life.
description: Global warming is a serious environmental threat to human life because of its effect on the climate. As temperatures rise due to increasing concentrations of greenhouse gases, the planet's climate changes and extreme weather conditions become more common. This affects food and water availability, air quality, disease prevalence and coastal habitability.
